title: MedAiCarePlus Terms of Service and Privacy Notice
what_changed: We now keep a record of which version of this notice you accepted, and when.
The notice now says who operates this installation and how to contact them.
Face enrollment photos, backups, and where each kind of data is processed are now described.
You can now export or delete your data in Settings → Privacy & data.

sections.heading: 1. Who is responsible for your data

blocks.text: This installation of MedAiCarePlus is operated by **{OPERATOR_NAME}**. Contact: **{OPERATOR_CONTACT}**.

sections.heading: 2. What the service does, and does not do

blocks.text: MedAiCarePlus helps you manage medication: reminders, recording when medicine is taken, mood tracking, and messages to family members you choose.

Detection of medicine taking and of mood is automated and can be wrong. The camera observes hand-to-mouth movement; **it cannot identify which pill you took or how many.** Do not rely on the app alone to decide whether you have taken a medicine.
MedAiCarePlus does not diagnose or treat, and does not replace your doctor, pharmacist, or a mental-health professional.
**It is not an emergency service and cannot call emergency services. In an emergency call 119.** If you are thinking about harming yourself, call **1925** (24 hours, free), **1995**, or **1980**.

items: Medication management, reminders, and recording doses.
Messages and alerts to family members you choose.
Signing you in, including face login.
Keeping the service secure and working.
Account: name, email, and your password, stored only as a one-way hash.
**Face enrollment photos** you take for face login: stored on the home server until you delete them or your account.
Medication records: names, doses, schedules, times taken, confirmations, and remaining stock.
Mood: facial-expression analysis results at medication time.
Live camera images while the app watches you take medicine: **analysed in memory and never saved.**
Family contacts: names, phone numbers, LINE IDs, and their responses to messages.
Sign-in history and the notifications sent to you and your family.

blocks.text: If this installation offers the Reachy Mini robot companion, it has a separate notice. The robot's camera, microphone, conversations, and safety alerts are switched on only after you read and accept that notice, and you can switch them off at any time.

You may ask to view, get a copy of, correct, stop the processing of, or delete your personal data, and you may withdraw any optional consent at any time. Contact **{OPERATOR_CONTACT}**, or use Settings → Privacy & data. Export and deletion are available there even if you have not accepted updated terms.
You need to accept this notice to use the app. If you do not, you can still export or delete your data and sign out.
When this notice changes, we will ask you to review and accept it the next time you open the app.
